Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is a proposal for you to review:

- Venue: our Studio, which takes up to 12 people and fits your group of 12 for a 4-hour booking.
- Catering: one coffee break for every attendee.



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 12 people x €8 | €96 |
| **Total** | | **€336** |
| Budget | | €400 |
| Difference | | €64 under budget |



The package fits within your budget.

Assumption: you didn't mention accessibility, so I have assumed nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio can only be reached by stairs. If anyone in your group needs a route without stairs, please tell me. In that case we would look at our Loft instead, which is wheelchair accessible, and I would recalculate the package.

Some other points:
- BrightRoom only offers 4-hour bookings.
- Availability has to be checked separately, and nothing is held for you at this stage.
- The listed prices are fixed.

If this suits you, tell me your preferred date and I will check availability.

Kind regards

reasons: All stated requirements are met, subject to the listed assumptions.
assumptions: Accessibility not stated: assumed no wheelchair access is needed. The Studio is stairs-only.

checks.detail: one coffee break for every attendee

standing_notes: Only 4-hour bookings exist; there is no longer-duration price.
Dates always need a separate availability check; nothing is booked or held.
No discounts of any kind are available.
